description: A protocol (instruction text) retrieved during dynamic check-in calls. Never searched directly: retrieval searches ProtocolAnchor and follows answeredBy. Hence vectorizer=none, matching SituationInstruction on weaviate-v2.

properties.name: instructionText
properties.description: The protocol body injected into the LLM context.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Short human label, used in traces and the retrieval S3 blob.

properties.name: documentVersionPath
properties.description: Source document + version this protocol was authored from.

properties.name: turnsThresholdCount
properties.description: How many turns this protocol stays resident in the LLM context. Absent, null or <= 0 falls back to the default of 3.

properties.name: isProduction
properties.description: Live in prod. Filtered on via the answeredBy cross-reference when ENVIRONMENT == "prod".

properties.name: isStaging
properties.description: Live in staging. Filtered on via the answeredBy cross-reference for every non-prod ENVIRONMENT.
